The complex mechanical linkage of the typebars in the center appears somewhat fused and lacks distinct individual arms. While stylized, the geometry becomes muddy and indistinct compared to the sharpness of the keys, suggesting minor structural coherence issues in the complex mechanical details.
The white lettering on the round keys is slightly uneven in thickness and alignment, lacking the crisp stamping quality of real vintage typewriters, though not severely distorted.
